CustomField.description: When ticked, an order placed in the Dealer Portal shop is set to Closed Won automatically right after it is placed. When not ticked, Sales processes it with the Process Order button. Whether a confirmation email is sent is set separately with Send Order Confirmation (Dealer Portal).
